dashboard.title: Olist 电商经营与履约看板
dashboard.description: 基于 Olist 公开数据的真实多表案例，覆盖订单、客户、商品、卖家、支付和评价。

metric_context.grain: 订单、订单项、支付和评价按各自业务粒度保存；查询时显式聚合后联表
source_notes: 来源为 Kaggle 上 Olist 发布的 Brazilian E-Commerce Public Dataset。
许可证为 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0；原始 CSV 不提交到代码仓库。
支付先按订单聚合，避免与订单项联接时产生一对多金额重复。

metrics.name: 支付总额
metrics.business_definition: 筛选范围内，每笔订单的全部支付记录之和。

metrics.name: 已送达率
metrics.business_definition: 状态为 delivered 的订单数除以筛选范围内全部订单数。

metrics.name: 商品成交额
metrics.business_definition: 订单项 price 之和，不包含运费。

dimensions.name: 购买月份
dimensions.business_definition: 订单创建时间所属自然月。

dimensions.name: 客户州
dimensions.business_definition: 订单对应客户地址的巴西州缩写。

dimensions.name: 商品英文品类
dimensions.business_definition: 商品原始葡萄牙语品类映射后的英文名称。

widgets.title: 支付总额
widgets.description: 筛选范围内按订单汇总后的支付金额。

query.sql: WITH payment_by_order AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS payment_total FROM olist_order_payments GROUP BY order_id) SELECT ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(p.payment_total, 0)), 2) AS payment_total FROM olist_orders o JOIN olist_customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN payment_by_order p ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE SUBSTR(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 4) IN (:years) AND c.customer_state IN (:states) AND (:status = 'all' OR o.order_status = :status)

WITH payment_by_order AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS payment_total FROM olist_order_payments GROUP BY order_id) SELECT SUBSTR(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 4) AS purchase_year, c.customer_state, o.order_status, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(p.payment_total, 0)), 2) AS payment_total FROM olist_orders o JOIN olist_customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN payment_by_order p ON p.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY SUBSTR(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 4), c.customer_state, o.order_status ORDER BY purchase_year, c.customer_state, o.order_status

widgets.title: 已送达率
widgets.description: 筛选订单中状态为 delivered 的占比。

query.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS delivered_rate FROM olist_orders o JOIN olist_customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE SUBSTR(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 4) IN (:years) AND c.customer_state IN (:states) AND (:status = 'all' OR o.order_status = :status)

SELECT SUBSTR(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 4) AS purchase_year, c.customer_state, o.order_status, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_count, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM olist_orders o JOIN olist_customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY SUBSTR(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 4), c.customer_state, o.order_status ORDER BY purchase_year, c.customer_state, o.order_status

widgets.title: 月度订单与支付趋势
widgets.description: 按购买月份比较订单量和支付总额。

query.sql: WITH payment_by_order AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS payment_total FROM olist_order_payments GROUP BY order_id) SELECT SUBSTR(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(p.payment_total, 0)), 2) AS payment_total FROM olist_orders o JOIN olist_customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN payment_by_order p ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE SUBSTR(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 4) IN (:years) AND c.customer_state IN (:states) AND (:status = 'all' OR o.order_status = :status) GROUP BY SUBSTR(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 7) ORDER BY month

WITH payment_by_order AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS payment_total FROM olist_order_payments GROUP BY order_id) SELECT SUBSTR(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 4) AS purchase_year, SUBSTR(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 7) AS month, c.customer_state, o.order_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(p.payment_total, 0)), 2) AS payment_total FROM olist_orders o JOIN olist_customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN payment_by_order p ON p.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY SUBSTR(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 4), SUBSTR(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 7), c.customer_state, o.order_status ORDER BY month, c.customer_state, o.order_status

widgets.title: Top 10 商品品类成交额
widgets.description: 商品 price 之和；先按订单筛选，再联接商品与英文品类。

query.sql: SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name, 'uncategorized') AS category, COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(i.price), 2) AS item_revenue FROM olist_orders o JOIN olist_customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN olist_order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN olist_products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id LEFT JOIN olist_category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE SUBSTR(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 4) IN (:years) AND c.customer_state IN (:states) AND (:status = 'all' OR o.order_status = :status) GROUP BY COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name, 'uncategorized') ORDER BY item_revenue DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT SUBSTR(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 4) AS purchase_year, c.customer_state, o.order_status, COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name, 'uncategorized') AS category, COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(i.price), 2) AS item_revenue FROM olist_orders o JOIN olist_customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN olist_order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN olist_products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id LEFT JOIN olist_category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name GROUP BY SUBSTR(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 4), c.customer_state, o.order_status, COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name, 'uncategorized') ORDER BY purchase_year, c.customer_state, o.order_status, category

widgets.title: 评价分数分布
widgets.description: 已提交评价按 1 至 5 分分组。

query.sql: SELECT r.review_score, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM olist_order_reviews r JOIN olist_orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id JOIN olist_customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE SUBSTR(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 4) IN (:years) AND c.customer_state IN (:states) AND (:status = 'all' OR o.order_status = :status) GROUP BY r.review_score ORDER BY r.review_score

SELECT SUBSTR(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 4) AS purchase_year, c.customer_state, o.order_status, r.review_score, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM olist_order_reviews r JOIN olist_orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id JOIN olist_customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY SUBSTR(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 4), c.customer_state, o.order_status, r.review_score ORDER BY purchase_year, c.customer_state, o.order_status, r.review_score

widgets.title: 订单分组核对表
widgets.description: 支付、商品和评价先聚合到订单粒度，再按年份、客户州和订单状态汇总核对。

query.sql: WITH payment_by_order AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS payment_total FROM olist_order_payments GROUP BY order_id), item_by_order AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS item_revenue, SUM(freight_value) AS freight_total FROM olist_order_items GROUP BY order_id), review_by_order AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(review_score) AS review_score_sum, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM olist_order_reviews GROUP BY order_id) SELECT SUBSTR(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 4) AS purchase_year, c.customer_state, o.order_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(p.payment_total, 0)), 2) AS payment_total, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(i.item_revenue, 0)), 2) AS item_revenue, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(i.freight_total, 0)), 2) AS freight_total, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(COALESCE(r.review_score_sum, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(r.review_count, 0)), 0), 2) AS average_review_score FROM olist_orders o JOIN olist_customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN payment_by_order p ON p.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN item_by_order i ON i.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN review_by_order r ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE SUBSTR(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 4) IN (:years) AND c.customer_state IN (:states) AND (:status = 'all' OR o.order_status = :status) GROUP BY SUBSTR(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 4), c.customer_state, o.order_status ORDER BY purchase_year DESC, payment_total DESC
query.grain: 购买年份、客户州、订单状态

query.sql: WITH payment_by_order AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS payment_total FROM olist_order_payments GROUP BY order_id), item_by_order AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS item_revenue, SUM(freight_value) AS freight_total FROM olist_order_items GROUP BY order_id), review_by_order AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(review_score) AS review_score_sum, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM olist_order_reviews GROUP BY order_id) SELECT SUBSTR(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 4) AS purchase_year, c.customer_state, o.order_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(p.payment_total, 0)), 2) AS payment_total, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(i.item_revenue, 0)), 2) AS item_revenue, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(i.freight_total, 0)), 2) AS freight_total, SUM(COALESCE(r.review_score_sum, 0)) AS review_score_sum, SUM(COALESCE(r.review_count, 0)) AS review_count FROM olist_orders o JOIN olist_customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN payment_by_order p ON p.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN item_by_order i ON i.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN review_by_order r ON r.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY SUBSTR(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 4), c.customer_state, o.order_status ORDER BY purchase_year, c.customer_state, o.order_status
